svg.title: MixRelay original glyph design before and after
svg.text: Reference = current Helvetica Neue Regular / A and B = original contours
SPACING / ALL PAIRS ARE SET INDIVIDUALLY
Mi ix xR Re el la ay
Values refer to ink-box gaps in 100-unit cap geometry; optical review remains visual.
No font outline is used in either candidate.
This is lettering for one product name, not a full custom typeface.
